reels.title: Diwali gift exchange
reels.caption: Ek soan papdi, poori society ki Diwali. Tumhare group mein soan papdi kaun ghumaata hai? Tag her!
reels.idea: At the kitty Diwali gift exchange every box opened is soan papdi; Myra is sure hers is kaju katli, and it turns out to be the very box she gave last year.
reels.beats: hook: Myra sure of kaju katli / esc: Ruhi soan papdi, Tina Dubai soan papdi, all boxes soan papdi / twist: Myra's box is soan papdi with "With love, Myra" / button: Myra rewraps it with the same kaju katli line

script.line: Mere wale mein kaju katli hai!
Darling, mera toh Dubai se aaya hai.
Poori society ki ek hi dukaan?!
Yeh toh maine pichhli Diwali di thi!
Ghoom ghoom ke ghar aa gayi.
Agli kitty... kaju katli hai, pakka!

review.notes: Every Indian household knows the soan papdi that travels from house to house at Diwali. One want (kaju katli), one game (every box is soan papdi), counter chip keeps it mute-proof, see-it reveal (name written on the box), button flips the opening line from hope to a con. Rewrite 1 cut Shruti and Tanya to keep 3 talkers and put the counter on screen.

reels.title: Sirf ek piece bana tha
reels.caption: Sirf ek piece bana tha... aur poori kitty ne pehna. Tag that friend who always says 'limited edition'!
reels.idea: Tina guards the door to show off her one-of-a-kind saree; every guest walks in wearing the same one, and finally so does the host.
reels.beats: hook: Tina 'sirf ek piece' twirl / setup: she guards the door / esc: Shruti same saree, Aditi same saree, sale tag on Tina / twist: host walks in in it with Tina's line / button: ALL 'Sale wali?!'

script.line: Darling, sirf ek piece bana tha!
Tina, andar aa ke baitho na!

review.notes: Same-saree panic is a real kitty moment every woman has lived. One want (be the only one), one game (each doorbell = another copy) with a PIECE # counter chip, all the same colour so it reads muted. Tina's show-off voice fits the lead; Shruti's price knowledge powers the tag beat. Twist is a see-it entry and mirrors the opening line. Rewrite 1 made Aditi silent (slurp only) to keep 3 talkers; endings tried: Tina rebrands it as group uniform, Tanya hands out more from a bag, ALL 'Sale wali?!' (kept, shortest and loops).

ideas.idea: Dhanteras kitty draw: Tanya shakes the chits bowl, "Iss baar kitty kiski niklegi?" and every lady is already shopping gold in her head (thought bubbles: jhumka, kangan, sikka). Ruhi wins and screams. End: Shruti opens her hisaab diary, "Teen mahine ka contribution pending hai, Ruhi ji", and Ruhi hands the whole envelope straight back.

End: under the wrapper is a sticker "With love, Myra", the same box she gave last year, now back home. Caption asks: "Tumhare group mein soan papdi kaun ghumaata hai?"

ideas.idea: Diwali potluck group chat: phone screen, host posts "Kal kitty potluck, sab kuch laana"; every reply is "Main kuch sweet le aaungi". Next day the doorbell rings again and again. End: the table has six boxes of kaju katli and not one namkeen, Tina walks in with a seventh.

ideas.idea: Diya on a spoon relay: teams pass an LED tealight diya on a steel spoon held in the mouth, no hands, down the line. Twist: the last lady must say a full Diwali wish to the host before she can drop it in the thali. 2 teams, 10 minutes.
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali week + Looks easy, isn't (DezNr1TO2xh, 298 likes)

ideas.idea: Andhi rangoli: in pairs, one lady is blindfolded and pours coloured rice or salt into a chalk diya outline on a thali, guided only by her partner's voice. 1 minute per pair. Twist: the guide must stand behind her, so left and right are flipped. Group votes the best diya.
ideas.source: Trend: Festival window: Diwali week + 1-minute rangoli (Diwali party game lists)

ideas.idea: Angrezi gaana: the host reads Bollywood song lines translated word for word into English ("Your face is a moon"). First lady to sing the original line wins a point; paper and pen to keep score. Twist: you must sing it, saying it does not count.
ideas.source: Trend: Hindi + English word puzzle (DewmgLDzEkC, 24 comments on 5 likes)

Akhbaar chhota hota jaayega, masti badhti jaayegi! Agli kitty mein yeh khelo. Aapki jodi kitne round tiki?
Diwali kitty ke liye perfect! Munh mein chammach, chammach par diya, aur aakhri lady ko wish bhi bolni hai. Aapki team mein sabse pehle diya kaun giraayega?

research.source: Our reel: "Comment or DM me. Chalo sabko batate hai Kitty Party Stories"
research.learn: Our best post ever (110k views, 1695 shares, 547 saves) asked viewers to comment to get something; end reels with a question the gang would answer in comments.

research.source: "Ye challenge dekhkar lag raha hai EASY... lekin WINNER banna itna aasaan nahi! 1 Minute Game"
research.learn: Frame the game as easy-looking, then show everyone failing; the dare to try it drives comments and tags.

research.source: "Kitty Party Paper Game! A unique English + Hindi word puzzle that challenges your brain"
research.learn: Puzzle games get far more comments than likes: viewers type their answers. A guessable puzzle on screen = free comments.

research.source: The Nod, Mar 2026: kitty party ladies, Instagram and "cringe" content (Matka Latka skits, Bridgerton kitties)
research.learn: Elaborately staged, costumed kitty skits are a watched mini-genre in 2026; dressed sets and costumes are the draw, matching our team feedback.

research.source: Dussehra and Diwali 2026 dates: Karwa Chauth 29 Oct, Dhanteras 6 Nov, Diwali 8 Nov, Bhai Dooj 11 Nov, Chhath 13-16 Nov
research.learn: Diwali kitties (card parties, gift exchange, potluck mithai) peak 1-3 weeks before 8 Nov; Karwa Chauth ideas must post by 28 Oct.
